guide.text: Grants a shield at low HP. Superman needs time for his Ultimate to build Attack bonus stacks, and the shield helps him survive long enough to reach the stacking limit, allowing him to deal devastating single-target damage.
Grants Catwoman a shield when her HP gets low. Her Dodge increases over time, and this shield helps her survive early on, giving her time to snowball with her Attack-steal effects.

Provides a shield at low HP. Since Supergirl relies on powerful bonuses from [Superman Family] allies present and needs time to build up Krypton Energy, the shield keeps her alive until her damage peaks.

Grants Atom a shield when his HP gets low. He stacks up Attack with basic attacks before unleashing explosive damage on all enemies. This shield keeps him alive long enough to build up Attack and deliver his devastating finisher.

Grants a shield when HP is low. Cassandra Cain relies on dodges and crits for damage, and this Legacy Piece helps keep her alive through the burst window after her Ultimate, allowing her to fully capitalize on her dodge-triggered slashes.
Improves Superman Death Metal's crits and helps him keep hitting hard after his Ultimate, making it a great fit for his burst-heavy playstyle.
